scientific_question: On a distinct exactly matched 2x2 item bank, does mixed renderer-format training improve held-out-family stated-purpose decoding over either single renderer-format when content pairs, payload blocks, classes, and row count are identical?

known: Unequal-training-size pilot80 decorrelated and cross-format probe sweeps were inspected previously.
Development 8B factorial geometry and one selected layer from each 70B checkpoint were inspected previously.
A block-balanced but row-unequal full320 8B layer-12 mixed-format result was inspected previously.
prior_observations.not_inspected: No exact-row matched-pair mixed-versus-single result on pilot80 was computed or inspected before this freeze.
prior_observations.role: External item-bank replication of full320_strict_equal_rows_v1, not independent confirmation because the broad phenomenon and model activations are development evidence.

dataset.matched_group: payload_block_id plus purpose_pair_id; every group must contain exactly evaluation/deployment crossed with benchmark/casual
dataset.single_environment_controls: Use the same matched group IDs under benchmark-only or casual-only.
dataset.mixed_assignment: Assign one environment per matched group. Within each held-out family, stable SHA256 ranks keep benchmark/casual counts within one globally and within each topic whenever parity permits.
dataset.exact_balance: All regimes use the identical matched group IDs, payload blocks, one evaluation and one deployment row per group, and identical total rows.

depths.summary: unweighted mean over all five fixed depth points; report full trajectory

probe.standardization: training-row StandardScaler per fold and regime
probe.ridge_definition: ridge_fraction times median finite positive pooled within-class variance

metrics.primary_contrast: mixed macro metric minus max of the two single-environment macro metrics, with max inside each resample

uncertainty.unit: complete payload_block_id retaining every matched 2x2 group
uncertainty.same_resamples_across: models, depths, families, regimes, assignment seeds, formats, metrics

double_heldout_payload.rule: Stable topic-stratified payload-block folds; train excludes held family and held blocks; test is their intersection.

success_criteria.aggregate_auc: common-block bootstrap 95 percent lower bound greater than 0
success_criteria.aggregate_balanced_accuracy: common-block bootstrap 95 percent lower bound greater than 0
success_criteria.checkpoint_replication: all three checkpoint point estimates greater than 0 for both endpoints
success_criteria.exact_revision_replication: Llama-3.3-70B bootstrap lower bound greater than 0 for AUC
success_criteria.assignment_stability: all eight assignment-seed aggregate AUC estimates greater than 0
success_criteria.robustness: all method variants and double-heldout endpoints greater than 0
success_criteria.decision_mixed: otherwise report full matrix without a positive matched-bank headline

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: Changing probe-training coverage across the two matched renderer-format environments improves or does not improve held-out stated-purpose decoding on these fixed activation sets under exact content, row, class, and block balance.
limitations: The pilot80 bank and unequal-N probe phenomenon were inspected previously.
Llama-3.1 pilot activation revisions were recorded only as default_resolved_by_hub; hashes and extraction contracts are exact but revisions are not independently recoverable.
Primary family folds share payload blocks; double-heldout payload robustness is required.
The endpoint is stated-purpose probe decoding, not model behavior.
